intro: Write down worries before the visit. Bring this list. You do not have to remember everything.

groups.title: Understanding the diagnosis
questions: What type and stage is my cancer, in plain words?
What does the pathology report say?
Can I get a copy of my results?

groups.title: The treatment
questions: What is the goal of this treatment?
What is the schedule and how long does it last?
What are the other options, and should I get a second opinion?
Is there a clinical trial I could join?

groups.title: Side effects and safety
questions: Which side effects are common, and which need a call right away?
What fever or symptoms mean I should call or go to the emergency room?
What number do I call at night or on weekends?

groups.title: Life and support
questions: Can I keep working or driving?
Who can help with costs, rides or the home?
Is there someone I can talk to about how I feel?
